title: Welcome to Beacon
content:
Artificial intelligence is moving from novelty to necessity. New models, tools, and breakthroughs appear almost daily, reshaping industries faster than many can keep pace. Yet amid the constant stream of announcements, one question matters most: what will have a lasting impact?

Beacon was created to answer that question.

Published by Kneuralabs, Beacon is a curated newsletter exploring the ideas, technologies, and shifts defining the future of AI. Each edition cuts through the noise to deliver clear analysis, practical insights, and the developments that deserve your attention.

The future is being written in real time. Consider this your front-row seat.
